title: Vibrant Earthy Australian Fig Bake
description: A low-calorie Australian dish featuring figs and earthy flavors, baked to perfection in a bamboo steamer. This meal-prep friendly recipe is perfect for a healthy snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, binchotan charcoal powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond milk, coconut oil, honey, and egg.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Gently fold in the chopped walnuts and Australian figs.
Place the dough in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Vibrant Earthy Australian Fig Bake warm, garnished with additional figs if desired.
